# Food Buff: Grilled Radhog Chops

**Buff**

| **Base Buff** | **Carnivore Mutation** | **Mutation and SIN Perk Card** | **Duration** |
| +3 Endurance | +6 Endurance | +7.5 Endurance | 15 minutes |

**Glowing Gut Perk Card**

Note: Carnivore mutation removes radiation from meat-based foods, so Grilled Radhog Chops will NOT give rads if the player has the Carnivore mutation.

| **Perk Rank** | **Total Rads** |
| None | 5 Rads |
| Rank 1 | 10 Rads |
| Rank 2 | 15 Rads |
| Rank 3 | 20 Rads |

**Spoil Rate**

| **Food Type** | **Base** | **30% Reduced** | **50% Reduced** | **60% Reduced** | **90% Reduced** |
| Cooked Meat Large | 4h 48m | 6h 14m | 7h 12m | 7h 41m | 9h 7m |

**Weight**

1.0 pounds

**How to obtain**

**Recipe**

Learned the first time you pick up Radhog Meat.

**Cooked Dish**

May in Highway Town in Burning Springs - Grilled Radhog Chops - 27.39%

**Recipe**

2x Wood

1x Spices

2x Radhog Meat

**Workbench**

Cooking Station > Meat

Cooking Station > All Food

**Stacking**

This is a food buff, so it will not stack with other Endurance food buffs.

It will stack with chems, alcohol, bobbleheads, magazines, and all other non-food categories.

**Technical**

**Form ID**

0084B86B

**Hunger Bar Restore**

1080 points

**Thirst Bar Restore**

0 points

**Radiation**

5 Rads

**Value**

12 caps

**Persists on World Change**

Yes

**Persists on death**

Not specified

**Keywords**

Object Type Food

Ingredient Type Meat

Meal Type Cooked

Object Type Can Spoil
